pages.name: Game Session
pages.description: Primary gameplay interface integrating the board, session scoreboard, move history log, and optional blitz timer. Adapts to a single-column stack on mobile and a two-column grid on desktop.

components.name: GameSessionPage
components.description: Top-level orchestrator managing game state, routing to sub-components, and handling match lifecycle events.

components.name: SessionScoreboard
components.description: Displays cumulative wins, losses, and draws for the current session. Reads/writes to localStorage on match conclusion and page load.

components.name: MoveHistoryLog
components.description: Scrollable vertical list rendering chronological move entries. Automatically clears when a new match initializes.

components.name: MoveHistoryEntry
components.description: Individual row displaying move sequence number, player identifier, placed symbol, and grid coordinate (e.g., A1, B3).

components.name: BlitzTimer
components.description: Countdown display showing remaining seconds per turn. Triggers automatic turn forfeit when reaching zero. Hidden when blitz mode is disabled.

components.name: GameControls
components.description: Action bar containing new match button, blitz mode toggle, and game mode selector. Updates UI state based on active match phase.

userFlows: Enable Blitz mode → Start match → Timer counts down → Player/CPU moves → Timer resets → Match concludes → Scoreboard updates via localStorage → Move history clears
Play standard match → Review chronological move log → Match ends → Win/Loss/Draw counters increment → Refresh page → Scoreboard values persist from localStorage

componentLibrary: Tailwind CSS with custom components, following the project's tech stack
responsiveStrategy: Mobile-first design. Single-column vertical stack on <640px. At sm (640px), scoreboard and controls align horizontally. At lg (1024px), layout splits into two columns: game board and timer on left, scoreboard and move history on right.
accessibilityLevel: WCAG 2.1 AA — all interactive elements keyboard-navigable, all images/content have text alternatives, color contrast minimum 4.5:1
colorPalette: Primary: #2563EB (actions, links), Success: #16A34A (completion), Error: #DC2626 (deletion, validation), Warning: #F59E0B, Neutral: #F3F4F6 (background), #6B7280 (secondary text)
typography: Sans-serif system font stack. Headings: text-2xl to text-4xl, font-semibold. Body: text-sm to text-base, font-normal
designTokens: radius: rounded-lg (8px) for cards/modals, rounded (4px) for buttons/inputs
shadows: shadow-sm for cards, shadow-md for modals, shadow-lg for dropdowns
